skills.name: Heart Afire
skills.desc: Deals Fire DMG equal to #1[i]% of Jiaoqiu's ATK to one designated enemy target.

skills.name: Scorch Onslaught
skills.desc: Deals Fire DMG equal to #1[i]% of Jiaoqiu's ATK to one designated enemy target and Fire DMG equal to #2[i]% of Jiaoqiu's ATK to adjacent targets, with a #3[i]% base chance to inflict 1 stack of "Ashen Roast" on the primary target.

skills.name: Pyrograph Arcanum
skills.desc:
Sets the number of "Ashen Roast" stacks on enemy targets to the highest number of "Ashen Roast" stacks present on the battlefield. Then, activates a Zone and deals Fire DMG equal to #1[i]% of Jiaoqiu's ATK to all enemies.
While inside the Zone, enemy targets receive #3[f1]% increased Ultimate DMG, with a #2[i]% base chance of being inflicted with 1 stack of Ashen Roast when taking action. While the Zone exists, this effect can trigger up to #5[i] time(s). And for each enemy target, it can only trigger once per turn. This trigger count resets every time Jiaoqiu uses Ultimate.
The Zone lasts for #4[i] turn(s), and its duration decreases by 1 at the start of this unit's every turn. If Jiaoqiu gets knocked down, the Zone will also be dispelled.

skills.name: Quartet Finesse, Octave Finery
skills.desc:
When Jiaoqiu hits an enemy with Basic ATK, Skill or Ultimate, there is a #1[i]% base chance to inflict 1 stack of Ashen Roast on them. At 1 stack, increases DMG received by the enemy by #2[f1]%. Then, each subsequent stack increases this by #3[f1]%.
Ashen Roast is capped at #4[i] stack(s) and lasts for #5[i] turn(s).
When an enemy target is afflicted with Ashen Roast, they are also considered as being Burned at the same time, taking Fire DoT equal to #6[i]% of Jiaoqiu's ATK at the start of each turn.

skills.name: Fiery Queller
skills.desc: After using Technique, creates a Special Dimension that lasts for #2[i] second(s). After entering combat with enemies in this Special Dimension, deals Fire DMG equal to #1[i]% of Jiaoqiu's ATK to all enemies, with a #3[i]% base chance of applying 1 "Ashen Roast" stack. Only 1 dimension created by allies can exist at the same time.

passives.name: Pyre Cleanse
passives.desc: When battle starts, immediately regenerates 15 Energy.

passives.name: Hearth Kindle
passives.desc: For every 15% of Jiaoqiu's Effect Hit Rate that exceeds 80%, additionally increases ATK by 60%, up to 240%.

passives.name: Seared Scent
passives.desc: While the Zone exists, enemies entering combat will be inflicted with Ashen Roast. The number of stacks applied will match the highest number of "Ashen Roast" stacks possessed by any unit while the Zone is active, with a minimum of 1 stack(s).
